about: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited manufactures, distributes, and trades in pharmaceuticals in India and internationally. The company offers adult and pediatric vaccines, such as Shingrix, Havrix, Fluarix Tetra, Varilrix, Infanrix Hexa, Boostrix, Synflorix, Menveo, and Priorix.
